history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration continue to reinforce guidance on multi-year project budget proposals, as well as on budget implementation.
history.administration_response: The Administration considers the recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure. The Administration has included, in the 2026 budget guide, additional guidelines and requests relating to multi-year project budget proposals in order to ensure that all information concerning the budgets of specific projects is consolidated and disclosed more coherently and consistently. To that effect, the Administration has expanded the content and requirements of the project proposal submissions and is conducting thorough reviews and validation.
history.board_assessment: Given that the relevant updates have been made to the budget guide for the proposed programme budget for 2026, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
